title: Missing Categorical Values Assessment
description: Evaluation and categorization of null, empty string, and whitespace records in categorical features.
conditions: Categorical feature contains null, empty strings (''), or blank spaces
Category cardinality is either low (< 20) or high (> 50)
Values represent administrative or clinical attributes
recommended_methods: Mode frequency replacement for low-missingness nominal variables (< 2%)
Missingness category preservation to model administrative non-response
selection_rules: If missingness > 5%, create an explicit 'Unknown' category rather than imputing mode
If categorical feature is an essential primary identifier, flag records for quarantine
If missingness is correlated with a specific cohort, document systematic reporting disparity
limitations: Imputing the mode artificially inflates category variance and distorts entropy
Adding 'Unknown' increases cardinality by 1 and may dilute rare subgroup signals
